svg.text: In VR: the cards in your hand, your wand on the star
The child stands at the lectern (no walking). Cards float in an arc; they speak in the hand; the Book's valley is at waist height
A card speaks in your hand
raise it to your ear to hear it again
its words float up past your eyes
Let go over a gap: it settles
elsewhere: it floats back to the arc
